---
title: "Generic Font Families"
brand: _brand.yml
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      # Q1 PR #11918 asserts fixed fonts (Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans Mono). Q2
      # picks the first available candidate per machine, so assert only that
      # no generic keyword is emitted.
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'font: \("[^"]+"'
          - 'codefont: \("[^"]+"'
        -
          - '"serif"'
          - '"sans-serif"'
          - '"monospace"'
---

```{=typst}
#set text(fallback: false)
```
